purpose: Describe the real capability target. This is not a benchmark suite and not a parity claim.

observed_capabilities: computer use across websites and desktop applications
professional work across documents spreadsheets presentations and business software
speed accuracy and judgment in demanding end-to-end work
multistep workflows across code browsers and professional software

user_goal: Make these capabilities genuinely real in Project Brain's own system and architecture. Do not optimize for Astra naming, implementation similarity, predicates, or benchmark completion.

capability_targets.target: Take an ambiguous consequential goal from start to finish across browser, code, files, and desktop/professional software; inspect outcomes; correct mistakes; finish usable work.
Discover missing knowledge from authoritative sources, judge relevance, synthesize only supported conclusions, and use it during execution.
Understand unfamiliar code, diagnose defects, implement production changes, test in realistic environments, and iterate to working software.
Produce immediately usable documents, spreadsheets, presentations, analyses, and software outputs while following context and constraints.
Solve difficult technical and scientific problems using reasoning, tools, computation, and verification.
Respect task boundaries, avoid unsupported claims, resolve routine ambiguity, ask only when outcome-critical, and change course correctly.
Preserve requirements, failed attempts, evidence, and state across long work, context loss, interruption, and restart.
Discover and select the right available tool or integration at runtime and combine tools without prewiring every path.

reason: Closing this gap forces reasoning, research, tool discovery, GUI/software action, artifact creation, verification, correction, persistence, and judgment to work together in one real system.
